question: Among the cards with converted mana cost higher than 5 in the set Coldsnap, how many of them have unknown power?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.power = '*' OR T1.power IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.convertedManaCost > 5

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) 
FROM cards c 
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code 
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND c.convertedManaCost > 5 AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL)

question: Among the sets in the block "Ice Age", how many of them have an Italian translation?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.block = 'Ice Age' AND T2.language = 'Italian' AND T2.translation IS NOT NULL

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) 
FROM sets s 
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode 
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age' AND st.language = 'Italian' AND st.translation IS NOT NULL

question: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'premodern' AND T3.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1.Side IS NULL

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) 
FROM legalities 
JOIN rulings ON legalities.uuid = rulings.uuid 
JOIN cards ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid 
WHERE legalities.format = 'premodern' 
AND rulings.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' 
AND cards.otherFaceIds IS NULL

turns.hint: otherFaceIds가 아니라 cards.side 컬럼으로 판단해야 해. 그리고 COUNT는 uuid 말고 id로 세야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cards.id) 
FROM legalities 
JOIN rulings ON legalities.uuid = rulings.uuid 
JOIN cards ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid 
WHERE legalities.format = 'premodern' 
AND rulings.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' 
AND cards.side IS NULL

question: Which foreign language used by "A Pedra Fellwar"?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

turns.sql: SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE uuid = (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar')

turns.hint: foreign_data 테이블에도 name 컬럼이 있어. cards랑 조인하지 말고 foreign_data.name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'로 직접 찾으면 돼. DISTINCT도 붙여야 해.
turns.sql: SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

question: What is the Italian flavor text of the card "Ancestor's Chosen"?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.flavorText FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND T2.language = 'Italian'

turns.sql: SELECT flavorText FROM foreign_data WHERE language = 'Italian' AND name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

turns.hint: foreign_data.name은 그 나라 언어로 번역된 이름이라, "Ancestor's Chosen"(원래 영어 이름)은 거기서 못 찾아. cards 테이블에서 name='Ancestor's Chosen'인 카드 찾은 다음, uuid로 foreign_data랑 조인해서 language='Italian'인 행을 찾아야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT fd.flavorText 
FROM foreign_data fd 
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid 
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Italian'

question: Lists all types of cards in German.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.subtypes, T1.supertypes FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.language = 'German' AND T1.subtypes IS NOT NULL AND T1.supertypes IS NOT NULL

turns.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT subtypes, supertypes 
FROM cards 
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid 
WHERE foreign_data.language = 'German' 
AND (subtypes IS NOT NULL OR supertypes IS NOT NULL)

turns.hint: DISTINCT 빼야 해. 조건도 OR가 아니라 AND로 (둘 다 NOT NULL이어야 함).
turns.sql:
SELECT subtypes, supertypes 
FROM cards 
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid 
WHERE foreign_data.language = 'German' 
AND subtypes IS NOT NULL 
AND supertypes IS NOT NULL

question: What is the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set Coldsnap?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND T1.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'

turns.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / 
    COUNT(*) * 100 AS percentage_incredibly_powerful
FROM 
    cards
WHERE 
    setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')

question: Please list the Italian text ruling of all the cards in the set Coldsnap.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.text FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian'

turns.sql:
SELECT r.text 
FROM rulings r 
JOIN cards c ON r.uuid = c.uuid 
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code 
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND r.language = 'Italian'

turns.hint: rulings 말고 foreign_data 테이블을 써야 해 (language 컬럼은 거기 있어). DISTINCT도 붙여야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT fd.text 
FROM foreign_data fd 
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid 
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code 
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'Italian'

question: Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

turns.sql:
SELECT c.id, r.text, 
       CASE 
           WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Missing or degraded properties and values' 
           ELSE 'No missing or degraded properties and values' 
       END AS property_status
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

turns.hint: CASE로 텍스트 변환하지 말고 hasContentWarning 값(0/1)을 그대로 반환해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT c.id, r.text, c.hasContentWarning
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

question: Did the set of cards with "Angel of Mercy" appear on Magic: The Gathering Online?
gold_sql: SELECT IIF(T2.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL, 'YES', 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T1.name = 'Angel of Mercy'

turns.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.name 
FROM cards c 
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code 
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy' AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL

turns.hint: set name이 아니라 mtgoCode가 NULL인지 여부를 'YES'/'NO'로 반환해야 해. WHERE에 mtgoCode 조건 넣지 말고, SELECT 안에서 IIF로 판단해.
turns.sql:
SELECT IIF(s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL, 'YES', 'NO') AS appears_on_mtgo
FROM cards c 
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code 
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of cards with format commander and legal status do not have a content warning?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'commander' AND T2.status = 'Legal'

turns.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'legal' AND l.format = 'commander' AND c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'legal' AND l.format = 'commander' THEN 1 END) * 100 AS percentage
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid

turns.hint: status 값은 소문자 'legal'이 아니라 대문자 'Legal'로 저장되어 있어. 그리고 WHERE절로 먼저 format='commander' AND status='Legal' 필터링한 다음, 그 안에서 SUM(CASE...)/COUNT(id)로 계산해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.id) AS percentage
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE 
    l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'

question: How many cards with original type of "Summon - Angel" have subtype other than "Angel"?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM cards WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' AND subtypes != 'Angel'

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' 
AND subtypes NOT LIKE '%Angel%'

turns.hint: subtypes NOT LIKE '%Angel%' 말고 subtypes != 'Angel'로 정확히 일치 비교해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' 
AND subtypes != 'Angel'
